title: herniaria pauciflora
intro: Herniaria pauciflora, commonly known as little snapweed or round-leaved snabwort, is a flowering plant in the carnation family that is native to Europe, Asia, and Africa. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Herniaria pauciflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
